headline: Promises and to-dos that name someone off limits keep their rows but show as "An item" across the Hub, your reminders included. All open and Focus now name the person who owes you, and leave out items an off-limits person owes you. Page sends, drafts and calendar changes always reach your book. Last names on their own, accented spellings and capitals are held, and a draft is checked one recipient at a time. After updating, say "update my hub" once and reload the Hub tab.
